name: V.S. Industry Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公告新的业务扩张、新业务或合约；公告主要为ESOS新股发行、股份拆细/额外上市、重大诉讼及董事会委员会人事变动。最新季度营收同比增长16.3%，但净利润为负。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any new business expansion, new business, or contracts; announcements mainly covered ESOS new share issues, share subdivision/additional listing, material litigation, and changes in board committees. Latest quarterly revenue grew 16.3% year-on-year, but net profit was negative.
